q: Can a small Villupuram rice mill replace its firewood paddy dryer with a gasifier, and what does it save?
title: Villupuram rice mills: firewood dryer swap
short: It can, and TERI's Villupuram profile estimates that a biomass gasifier making hot air from husk or wood saves 30 to 50% of dryer fuel. Fitted to the district's 40 or so 2 tph mills, it would save about 900 toe a year, roughly 56 t of firewood equivalent per mill (estimate).
audience: Small parboiling rice mills in Villupuram, Tindivanam, Vikravandi, Kallakurichi and Chinnaselam

sections.h: Why the small mills burn wood
p: In Villupuram's 4 tph mills, steam at about 8 kg per cm2 heats the air that dries parboiled paddy. The 2 tph mills mostly fire wood straight into a hot air dryer instead. Firewood meets about 20% of the district's mill heat, 5,640 t a year, and it is the one fuel they buy: about Rs 19.7 million a year across the cluster. A typical 2 tph mill uses 131 toe of heat and 8 toe of electricity a year.

ul: Husk or wood is turned into producer gas, which burns cleanly and can be controlled, instead of burning the fuel directly.
TERI's estimate: 30 to 50% less fuel for the same drying.
It can run on husk freed up by boiler improvements, so bought firewood falls first.

sections.h: Do the boiler at the same time
ul: Economiser and condensate return, feedwater up to 90 C: about 10% less husk. Across about 50 mills, 2,304 t of husk (744 toe), worth about Rs 28 lakh a year.
Solar water heating for soaking water: about 421 t of husk (136 toe) a year.
Insulate steam and hot water lines, and fit steam traps where the small mills have none.

sections.h: What to record before and after
ol: Firewood bought each month, with bills and weights.
Paddy dried, and moisture before and after the dryer.
The same months a year apart, so a lender can see the change.

example.title: One 2 tph mill (estimate)
lines: If all firewood goes to the 40 small mills: 5,640 t / 40 = about 141 t a year each
At 30 to 50% saved: 42 to 70 t of wood a year
At the cluster's cost, Rs 19.7 million / 5,640 t = about Rs 3,500 a tonne: Rs 1.5 to 2.5 lakh a year
TERI's figure: 900 toe / 40 mills = 22.5 toe each, about 56 t of wood equivalent at 0.4 toe per tonne
Wood CO2 avoided, reported as biogenic: 22.5 toe x 41.868 GJ x 112 kg = about 105 t a year
example.note: From TERI's Villupuram profile (2014-15). The split of firewood between mills is an assumption; wood CO2 uses the IPCC 2006 default for wood. Your own bills give the real figures.

senseible: The green loan check shows what a lender wants before funding a dryer change. Senseible keeps your firewood, husk and power bills in one dated record, so the before and after comes from documents.
